general.notes: Copper (RJ-45) SFP transceiver over Category 5 UTP; not an optical module. LP-SFP-TM8I ordering row specifies industrial case temperature -40 to +85°C and Marvel 88E1111 PHY with SGMII. Datasheet also documents commercial 0 to +70°C for other order codes. Symbol rate stated as 250 Mbps on each of four pairs (5-level PAM per IEEE 802.3). Table 5 data rate min/max printed as 10 and 1,000 Mb/sec. Cable reach 100 m (Category 5 UTP, BER <10^-12); ordering tables also state Transmission Distance 0.1 Km. Power consumption and surge current exceed SFP MSA limits per caution note. Line frequency (Table 3) typ 125 MHz. bit_rate_gbps mixes values as printed in Mb/sec and Gb/s without unit conversion.
general.suggestions: Add form factors SFP and connector RJ-45 for copper modules. Add cable media types (Cat5 UTP). Clarify whether bit_rate_gbps should accept Mb/s literals or require normalized Gbps. number_of_lanes=4 inferred from four twisted pairs, not labeled as lanes in the datasheet.
